reviews.x: Great to use as shower caps or for deep conditioning.  Small packaging allows for easy storage.  Plus now I don’t have to share my shower cap with guests.  My hair is pretty full and natural and falls just below my face and it is a good fit.  Definitely not for naturals with hair past your shoulders unless you have thin hair.
I use them for my salon it’s great since it does not take s lot of space and it’s easy to use

reviews.t: Perfect for travel and home use!
reviews.x: These are perfect for when I leave conditioner in my hair or to protect my hair when I'm doing my own facials. They don't take up much room in the linen closet because of the compact packaging. Great for travel too. No wet musty shower cap thrown in your bag simply throw away after use! I'm glad I made this purchase. They've really come in handy.

I’m blown away by how many have come with This order and so reasonably priced! I usually hate shower caps because I sweat in my hair but these leave a little breathing room by the ears and I love the convenience of how small They’re folded up. It reminds me of hotel shower caps!
Bought them for a project. They were very easy to work with
Love these shower caps, barely take any space to store.

reviews.t: I would NOT RECOMMEND this buy
reviews.x: This product is consisted of a piece of square plastic tapered at bilateral edges. The elasticity which should enclose the edges are lacking and appear short ended in the margins. In short, it is not a cap. It is unable to cover your hair protectively whether for a steam or from outside moisture. It is very inadequate for the stated purpose. It is a sure return and I will be very careful of the products I get on this marketplace going forward.

reviews.t: CHEAP...elastic pops and makes the cap useless
reviews.x: This seemed like a good value for the money but you get what you pay for.  Once I opened up a cap for use the elastic popped leaving about 2-3 inches of elastic and the rest a shapeless blob. This means that the rest of the cap is loose and doesn't even conform to the head so it's useless to seal in hair treatments.  I thought maybe one was defective but this happened on 5 caps.  The plastic is very flimsy Waste of money.

100 "frosted" plastic caps. Makes it hard to see through, but it's fine. The cute way they were folded in the bags will stump most people as to what they are. 100 pieces divided evenly into two clear bags. Makes for quick and easy storage. 100 pieces guaranteed to have for a while. Perfect for large families. I would definitely purchase again.

The quality of these caps is fine (at least the ones I got), but they are very small.  I have a small head and short hair, but they are tight and pin my hair to my head.  They do keep my hair dry in the shower and can be reused several times.  I have not had any problems with the elastic.  I only wish they were a little larger.

Absolutely total waste of money for such a  terrible quality and product. It breaks when unfolding in before even using it. I bought 100 of them and I had to throw away about 50 because the elastic breaks when unfolding it and the plastic part is SO THIN. Never seen any thing with this thin plastic ever.

I do not use these for their intended purpose. I cover the top of my boots in the garage with these to keep bugs out. I also cover my shoes with these when I travel to keep my clothes and suitcase clean. Takes up minimal space but good to have around because you can use them for so many things.

reviews.t: Got what I paid for and will use until they're gone
reviews.x: Too thin and rip very easily. We have thick hair and big heads, but still these caps were way too thin and ripped just from opening them up to put on. I still use them for my toddlers. Might as well since there were so many in the pack, which was nice but wish they were a little better quality.

Loved this package of shower caps. They are perfect when you need a disposable shower cap. I try and keep several in my travel bag and they can be used more than once. The quality is surprising for the price! Love them!

Needed shower caps badly....could NOT find this type anywhere until I thought about Amazon...couldnt believe the price and the fit is great........Thank You so much AGAIN!!!!!!!!. Price beyond Unbelievable too!!!!!!!

I would not even give it one star but negatives are not an option. It looks like a garter belt but when you open the cap the elastic is no longer. It's like putting a piece of saran wrap on your head. Ridiculous!!

I have a small head, often wear children's sized sunglasses & protective glasses. Even my head was too big for these. The minute you stretch out to go over your head, the elastic breaks. Small & very poor quality.

These are snug in size and a little pricy in comparison to what I get from walmart. Due to that, they are uncomfortable to wear. Rips easily and doesnt last more than two times. Packaging was horrible.
Extremely thin plastic. I didn’t realize how thin they are. When I was pulling the cap over my head, it broke. And the elastic fell apart. Not a good product. Next time I’ll spend more.
The picture of this product is very misleading. There is no rubber around the entire caps at all. They are pinched on two sides with a small section of rubber. Horrible!
I use the disposable shower caps when I color my hair to keep the hair dye off of any household items. These work perfectly. They're light and fit well.

reviews.t: Not good if you have a lot of hair
reviews.x: If you have a lot of hair this is not the product for you.the band rips very easily. It took me three just to cover my hair.mostly seems like kid size
These are not like the normal plastic caps. The elastic is not strong. Once opened it tears and you have one big piece of plastic with no elastic.
I do a lot of domestic traveling and these are perfect. Use one throw it away. They don't take up any space. 100 per pack so you never run out.
These hats are sturdy and really heavy duty.  They come in a zip lock back and are really compact which is great.  I will definitely buy again.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the caps convenient and compact, praising how little space they take up for storage and travel.
Several reviewers report the caps are good value, noting the large quantity and low price.
A number of reviewers complain about poor quality, with thin plastic and elastic that breaks or pops, making the caps useless.
Some reviewers note the caps run small and are tight, especially for those with thick hair or big heads.
Multiple reviewers appreciate that the caps can be reused more than once.
